title: [Main]-Production BOM Version certification does not check Variant Mandatory on lines
summary: Production BOM Version certification now validates that variant codes are populated for items marked as Variant Mandatory, preventing incomplete configurations from being certified.
key_points: Adds validation during Production BOM Version certification
Checks that Variant Code is populated for items with Variant Mandatory enabled
Prevents certification of incomplete Production BOM lines with mandatory variants
Includes test coverage for the new validation logic
